name: salesforce-skills
description: Public Salesforce AI skills by Tony Ward
author: tonygward

skills.name: salesforce-naming-things
skills.description: Naming conventions for Apex and LWC — intent-revealing names, no encodings, one word per concept, Salesforce conventions table

skills.name: salesforce-code-comments
skills.description: When and how to comment Salesforce code (Apex and LWC) — the why-not-how rule, ApexDoc/JSDoc, and what to delete

skills.name: salesforce-writing-tests
skills.description: How to write high-quality Salesforce tests (Apex and LWC Jest) — FIRST principles, Assert class, bulk testing, mocking

skills.name: salesforce-tests-as-specification
skills.description: Write Salesforce tests that act as a living specification — one rule per test, Given/When/Then, boundary cases

skills.name: salesforce-tdd-workflow
skills.description: TDD workflow for Salesforce — red/green/refactor, three laws of TDD, one change at a time

skills.name: generating-apex-test-httpmocks
skills.description: Generate Apex test classes for HTTP callout code using the self-shunt pattern

skills.name: clean-salesforce-functions
skills.description: Apply Clean Code function principles to Salesforce code (Apex and LWC JavaScript) — small, one thing, few arguments, no flag args, no side effects, CQS

skills.name: clean-apex-error-handling
skills.description: Apply Clean Code error-handling principles to Apex — exceptions over flags, custom types, no nulls, separate error from logic

skills.name: reviewing-apex
skills.description: Review existing Apex against Clean Code smells and heuristics — duplication, God classes, magic numbers, test quality, Apex architecture

skills.name: salesforce-connascence
skills.description: Analyse and reduce coupling in Apex and LWC using connascence — a strength-ranked taxonomy (name, type, meaning, position, algorithm, execution, timing, value, identity) judged by strength, degree, and locality

skills.name: salesforce-solid-design
skills.description: Apply the SOLID object-oriented design principles to Apex — SRP/OCP/LSP/ISP/DIP, trigger/handler/service/selector layering, strategy via CMDT, and dependency injection for DML/SOQL-free unit tests

skills.name: salesforce-design-patterns
skills.description: Apply the Decorator and Strategy patterns to Apex and LWC JavaScript and prefer composition over inheritance — Strategy via CMDT or a JS config map, Decorator/slots to stack behaviour, realise the Open/Closed Principle

skills.name: salesforce-primitive-obsession
skills.description: Replace raw primitives that carry domain meaning with small, immutable value objects in Apex and LWC JavaScript — validate on construction, attract behaviour to the type, hoist magic strings to constants, group data clumps; primitive obsession as connascence of meaning

skills.name: salesforce-law-of-demeter
skills.description: Apply the Law of Demeter and Tell-Don't-Ask to Apex and LWC JavaScript — avoid train-wreck getter/relationship/template chains, command objects (and child components) instead of querying their state, keep behaviour with the data it concerns

skills.name: lwc-component-design
skills.description: Design Lightning Web Components with the grain of the framework — minimal @api surface, correct reactivity (reassign not mutate, getters not stored derived state), @wire vs imperative Apex, lifecycle hooks, data-down/events-up, and composition with slots and child components
